exampleEn: It's important for a team to see eye to eye on their goals.
exampleKo: 팀이 목표에 대해 의견이 일치하는 것이 중요하다.
gameExamples: My brother and I rarely see eye to eye on politics.
In a successful partnership, both sides must see eye to eye on key issues.
Despite their differences, the colleagues managed to see eye to eye during the project meeting.
